Sub Setup()
Dim f As Object

Set f=Range("M9:M10,K3:K5").FormatConditions.Add(2,Formula1:="=M9>0")
f.Font.Bold=True
End Sub
probes.inspection_source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As Object,c As Range,s As String
Set f=ActiveSheet.Cells.FormatConditions(1)
s="applies=" & f.AppliesTo.Address & ";formula=" & f.Formula1
For Each c In ActiveSheet.Range("K3:K5,M9:M10")
s=s & ";" & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CStr(c.DisplayFormat.Font.Bold)
Next
Probe=s
End Function

Set f=ActiveSheet.Cells.FormatConditions(1)
s="applies=" & f.AppliesTo.Address & ";formula=" & f.Formula1
For Each c In ActiveSheet.Range("B9:B10,K3:K5")
s=s & ";" & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CStr(c.DisplayFormat.Font.Bold)
Next
Probe=s
End Function
